name: Flash
description: Make an object temporarily flash, alternately becoming visible and invisible.

conditions.description: True if the object is currently flashing.
Triggered when the object stops flashing.

actions.description: Make the object flash for a period of time.

on-time.name: 'On' time
on-time.desc: Duration in seconds the object is visible.

off-time.name: 'Off' time
off-time.desc: Duration in seconds the object is invisible.

duration.name: Duration
duration.desc: Duration in seconds the object flashes for.

actions.description: Stop the flashing and set the object visible.
